meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,用户可以在 Emacs 的聊天缓冲区向 Claude 提问并收到回复;也可以把选中的 org 区域或标题发过去,回答作为子标题写回 org 文件,消息自动从 markdown 转成 org-mode 格式。
howto.when: 当用户在 Emacs 中打开聊天缓冲区(如按 C-c n c 或 SPC N c),或对 org 内容执行发送命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释一下这个函数的报错原因
say.note: 消息会从 Emacs 聊天缓冲区发出,回复显示在缓冲区里。

say.text: 把选中的这段代码做个 review
把这条议程整理成行动项
say.note: 回复会以子标题写回 org 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, users can talk to Claude in an Emacs chat buffer and receive replies; they can also send a selected org region or heading, and the answer is inserted as a child heading. Messages are converted from markdown to org-mode automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user opens the chat buffer in Emacs (e.g. C-c n c or SPC N c), or sends org content via the org-send command.

say_en.text: Explain why this function is throwing an error.
say_en.note: The message is sent from the Emacs chat buffer; the reply appears there.

say_en.text: Turn this agenda entry into action items.
say_en.note: The reply is written back as a child heading in the org file.
